title: AuraLairs 1.21 [Pvper]
body:
**🎮 Vanilla Friend Pack – Clean PvP for 1.21**
Vanilla Friend Pack is a lightweight, PvP-focused resource pack designed for players who love the look and feel of Minecraft 1.21, but want a cleaner and more competitive visual experience.

Made specifically for PvPers, this pack removes visual clutter and enhances clarity, while staying true to the vanilla art style.

🧊 Features:
- ✅ Better Grass – Smooth, seamless grass textures for a cleaner terrain
  
- 💧 Clean Water – Transparent water for better visibility underwater
  
- 🛡️ Low Shield – Smaller shield model so it doesn't block your screen
  
- 🔥 Low Fire – Fire lowered to reduce screen obstruction in combat
  
- 🍎 Low Gapple – Minimal golden apple effects for better focus
  
- 💠 Transparent GUI – Sleek and clear inventory and menus
  
- 🎞️ Animated Items – Subtle vanilla-style animations for tools and weapons
  
- 📦 Improved Models – Slight tweaks to models while keeping it vanilla-friendly
  
⚔️ Ideal For:
PvP players who want unobstructed vision

Fans of vanilla Minecraft aesthetics

Anyone who wants a clean and minimal look while fighting

🧪 Compatibility:
✅ Fully compatible with Minecraft 1.21

🎮 Works great with vanilla servers, PvP events, or UHC

🌟 Made by PvPers, for PvPers.
If you want a clean, vanilla-friendly look with competitive advantages, this pack is for you.
